text: Security is a key part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data as it travels between the user and the server. Authentication helps confirm that users are who they claim to be, usually through strong passwords or two-factor login. Developers must also check all user input carefully, because input validation prevents harmful code from entering the system. Common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, often appear when these basic rules are ignored. By focusing on HTTPS, reliable authentication, and strict input validation, developers can reduce risks and build safer websites for everyone.
